SIMCONNECT_DATA_INITPOSITION

Defines the initial position and orientation used to place an aircraft in the simulation world.

Syntax

struct SIMCONNECT_DATA_INITPOSITION {
  double Latitude;
  double Longitude;
  double Altitude;
  double Pitch;
  double Bank;
  double Heading;
  DWORD  OnGround;
  DWORD  Airspeed;
};

Members

Member Type Description
Latitude double Latitude in decimal degrees. Positive values are north of the equator.
Longitude double Longitude in decimal degrees. Positive values are east of the prime meridian.
Altitude double Altitude above mean sea level in feet.
Pitch double Pitch angle in degrees. Positive values represent nose-up pitch.
Bank double Bank (roll) angle in degrees.
Heading double True heading in degrees, measured clockwise from true north.
OnGround DWORD Set to 1 to place the aircraft on the ground surface.
Airspeed DWORD Initial indicated airspeed in knots.

Remarks

When OnGround is set to 1 the Altitude field is ignored.
